# SenseVoice Small

Model: SenseVoice Small, FunAudioLLM / Alibaba Group.

- Original model: https://huggingface.co/FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall
- Original project: https://github.com/FunAudioLLM/SenseVoice
- INT8 conversion and tokens: csukuangfj / sherpa-onnx
- Conversion repository: https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue-2024-07-17
- Pinned conversion revision: `2365baeacb507f821a0c8120fcee3d484dba7a07`
- The conversion's LICENSE refers to FunASR licensing. The bundled `SenseVoice-MODEL-LICENSE.txt` is the FunASR Model Open Source License Agreement, version 1.1, obtained from https://github.com/modelscope/FunASR/blob/58830eca4012644aac0c3218c3ccc7d98f003fda/MODEL_LICENSE.
- Runtime: sherpa-onnx-node, Apache-2.0. Audio decoder: ogg-opus-decoder, MIT. Their package licenses remain with the packaged dependencies.

The model weights may be included in offline test installers or downloaded separately after the user selects Download Model. OpenType retains the model name and source attribution in its model settings. Bundled weights are verified before they are copied into the user's writable model cache.
